The role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business objectives and user requirements.  The role involves researching, analysing and documenting system requirements, writing and maintaining code, testing and debugging applications, supporting software deployments, resolving technical issues and contributing to the ongoing improvement of software systems. Job no: 942438

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Administration, Business and Management, Information and Library Services




 

Department for Health and Wellbeing - Clinical System Support & Improvement - Chief Medical Officer - SA Health Library Service

Salary: $91,565 to $106,074 - PO2 - Full Time - Ongoing - Permanent

Overview:

The SA Health Library Service (SAHLS) provides a high quality, evidence-based library service to support the clinical, educational, research and public health needs of the SA Health workforce. The SAHLS Reference Librarian participates in the delivery of a high-level reference and information service for SA Health staff, including literature searches, reference work, research support, user education and training programs, and the promotion of Library services.

This position works across two CALHN sites: The Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the Royal Adelaide Hospital, with time at each site based on operational needs. As SAHLS is a statewide service, there may also be a requirement to work at other metropolitan library sites.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 942438

Criminal History Screening Requirement

A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment).

Immunisation Risk for this position is Category C (minimal aptient contact).

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Special Condition

A tertiary qualification in library and information studies conferring eligibility for Associate Membership of the Australian Library and Information Association (ALIA).
